purpose: Versioned parity denominator. Every change to obligation or scope-item membership, their counts, the workflow count, or workflow allocation needs a new entry with a unique version and reason; the register's denominator_version is the last entry. Earlier entries were reconstructed from the Git history of parity-obligations.json; their digests use the same definition with no workflow allocation.
digest_definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON {obligation_ids: sorted, scope_item_ids: sorted, workflow_assignments: {obligation_id: workflow_id}}
